answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Diamond sorter carved cameo seal witnessed by the cutters ledger changes that arithmetic: each carved cameo is a measured facet angle plus a guild signature, so a farm must sort a hundred real diamonds by hand, so the glacier for each fake is paid in the real world. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the fable of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The jade is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
